Name: 黑日之后
Description:
特瑞厄斯
黑日之后，特瑞厄斯失去了真正的黎明，只剩下几颗残星在未被遮蔽的天空下散发暗淡的光。
Description_zh-Hant:
特瑞厄斯
黑日之後，特瑞厄斯失去了真正的黎明，只剩下幾顆殘星在未被遮蔽的天空下散發暗淡的光。
Description_en:
Terrius
After the Black Sun, Terrius lost the true dawn and still counted tomorrow beneath a scorched sky.
Description_ja:
Terrius
After the Black Sun, Terrius lost the true dawn and still counted tomorrow beneath a scorched sky.

Name: 第二日轮
Description:
特瑞厄斯
白曜圣庭制造了第二日轮，重新划分昼夜。
Description_zh-Hant:
特瑞厄斯
白曜聖庭製造了第二日輪，重新劃分晝夜。
Description_en:
Terrius
The White Radiance Court made the Second Sun, an artificial sun that divided day and night without rising or setting.
Description_ja:
Terrius
The White Radiance Court made the Second Sun, an artificial sun that divided day and night without rising or setting.

Name: 圣女的日常
Description:
白曜圣庭
乌娜每日都会在圣殿长廊为人们念出祷言。
Description_zh-Hant:
白曜聖庭
烏娜每日都會在聖殿長廊為人們念出禱言。
Description_en:
White Radiance Court
Una once walked between corridors and wards as the gentlest proof of the Second Sun.
Description_ja:
White Radiance Court
Una once walked between corridors and wards as the gentlest proof of the Second Sun.

Name: 被污染的光
Description:
白曜圣庭
一处街区失去了颜色，一个母亲忘记了孩子。
Description_zh-Hant:
白曜聖庭
一處街區失去了顏色，一個母親忘記了孩子。
Description_en:
White Radiance Court
Color vanished first, then a person's name and traces were quietly erased by the light of the Second Sun.
Description_ja:
White Radiance Court
Color vanished first, then a person's name and traces were quietly erased by the light of the Second Sun.

Name: 心哀与挣扎
Description:
圣轮
沉默的夜晚，一行行名字被悄然烧去。
Description_zh-Hant:
聖輪
沉默的夜晚，一行行名字被悄然燒去。
Description_en:
Sacred Wheel
The Court chose silence, while Una heard the crying in empty rooms and the final names of the erased.
Description_ja:
Sacred Wheel
The Court chose silence, while Una heard the crying in empty rooms and the final names of the erased.

Name: 圣轮之上
Description:
圣轮
乌娜戴上曜日冠冕，将被污染的光辉与众生祈祷一并收入体内。
Description_zh-Hant:
圣轮
乌娜戴上曜日冠冕，将被污染的光辉与众生祈祷一并收入体内。
Description_en:
Sacred Wheel
Una wore the Solar Crown and drew polluted light and every prayer into herself.
Description_ja:
Sacred Wheel
Una wore the Solar Crown and drew polluted light and every prayer into herself.

Name: 日耀事件
Description:
未知
翻开一页被尘封的记录，旧迹之下是一段难言的过往。
Description_zh-Hant:
未知
翻開一頁被塵封的記錄，舊跡之下是一段難言的過往。
Description_en:
Unknown
Open a dust-sealed record. Beneath the old traces lies a past too hard to speak of.
Description_ja:
Unknown
Open a dust-sealed record. Beneath the old traces lies a past too hard to speak of.

Name: 日耀回忆
Description:
乌娜
本层日耀回忆在日轮残光中展开。确认套卡后，踏入首领连战。
Description_zh-Hant:
烏娜
本層日耀回憶在日輪殘光中展開。確認套卡後，踏入首領連戰。
Description_en:
Una
Solar Memory opens for this layer in the remaining sunlight. Review the deck, then enter the boss rush.
Description_ja:
Una
Solar Memory opens for this layer in the remaining sunlight. Review the deck, then enter the boss rush.

Name: 白曜镜阵
Description:
白曜圣庭
三千面环日镜仍在按照旧日钟律校准第二日轮。
Description_zh-Hant:
白曜聖庭
三千面環日鏡仍在按照舊日鐘律校準第二日輪。
Description_en:
White Radiance Court
Three thousand orbit mirrors still calibrate the Second Sun by the old bells.
Description_ja:
White Radiance Court
Three thousand orbit mirrors still calibrate the Second Sun by the old bells.

Name: 无慈第二日轮
Description:
圣轮
第二日轮仍在完整运行，照亮、净化，并抹去每一个名字。
Description_zh-Hant:
聖輪
第二日輪仍在完整運行，照亮、淨化，並抹去每一個名字。
Description_en:
Sacred Wheel
The Second Sun still runs: lighting, purifying, and erasing every name.
Description_ja:
Sacred Wheel
The Second Sun still runs: lighting, purifying, and erasing every name.

Name: 白曜圣女·乌娜
Description:
乌娜
过去的圣女站在完整的白昼中，温柔地要求一切回到洁净秩序。
Description_zh-Hant:
烏娜
過去的聖女站在完整的白晝中，溫柔地要求一切回到潔淨秩序。
Description_en:
Una
The former saint stands in intact daylight and gently asks all things to return to spotless order.
Description_ja:
Una
The former saint stands in intact daylight and gently asks all things to return to spotless order.
